name: Raised PO for SO
query:
SELECT 
    so.name AS "Sales Order:Link/Sales Order:120",
    so.transaction_date AS "Sales Order Date:Date:120",
    so.customer AS "Customer:Link/Customer:150",
    soi.item_code AS "Item Code:Link/Item:120",
    soi.item_name AS "Item Name:Data:150",
    soi.qty AS "Required Qty:Float:100",
    bin.actual_qty AS "Available Qty:Float:100",
    (soi.qty - IFNULL(bin.actual_qty, 0)) AS "Shortfall Qty:Float:100"
    
FROM 
    `tabSales Order` so
JOIN 
    `tabSales Order Item` soi ON so.name = soi.parent
LEFT JOIN 
    `tabBin` bin ON soi.item_code = bin.item_code AND soi.warehouse = bin.warehouse

WHERE 
    so.docstatus = 1  -- Only submitted Sales Orders
    AND bin.actual_qty < soi.qty  -- Available stock is less than required qty

ORDER BY 
    so.transaction_date DESC, so.name;
